parts.name: Left Button
parts.Basic_description: The left button of a computer mouse made of ABS plastic, typically located on the top-left side of the mouse.
parts.Functional_description: It is used for primary clicking actions such as selecting, dragging, and interacting with software interfaces.
parts.Movement_description: It moves vertically when pressed and returns to its original position via a spring mechanism.

parts.name: Right Button
parts.Basic_description: The right button of a computer mouse made of ABS plastic, located on the top-right side of the mouse.
parts.Functional_description: It is used for secondary clicking actions such as opening context menus or performing alternate functions.
parts.Movement_description: It moves vertically when pressed and returns to its original position via a spring mechanism.

parts.name: Scroll Wheel
parts.Basic_description: A rubber scroll wheel located between the left and right buttons of the mouse.
parts.Functional_description: It allows the user to scroll vertically or horizontally through content and can also act as a middle button when pressed.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around its horizontal axis and can be pressed vertically.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The main body of the computer mouse made of ABS plastic, forming the structural housing for internal components.
parts.Functional_description: It provides ergonomic support for the hand and houses the electronic components, sensors, and buttons.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary relative to its internal components but moves as a whole across a surface during use.
